instruction: Configure Ubuntu to show weekday names in the system clock display.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling weekday display in the system clock. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent enabled it (changed to true). Uses GNOME interface schema.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the GNOME clock-show-weekday setting using gsettings command
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares the result against the expected value 'true\n'
Expected value is semantically correct - enabling weekday display requires clock-show-weekday=true
Complete coverage - the single requirement (show weekday names) is fully verified
No timing or state issues - gsettings value is persistent and can be queried anytime
Evaluator logic will correctly determine if the instruction was completed
